<div class="testimonials-description">
<p>&ldquo;The SABRE Awards put a spotlight on the industry's most compelling work, especially focusing on programs and initiatives that drive real business impact. Winning a SABRE is not only a huge validation for the increasingly strategic role of insight-driven and measurable communications, but it is a galvanising moment for our teams who take great pride in the work they do together with our clients&rdquo;</p>

<div class="testimonials-description">
<p>&ldquo;PRovoke Global brings together some of the most influential people and most inspiring content from across the worldwide PR industry. For independent agency leaders, the Entrepreneurs&rsquo; Forum offers key insights on managing a communications consultancy from around the planet. The main conference itself is brainfood of the highest quality, providing new perspectives on established and emerging communications disciplines. The Global SABREs spotlight the best campaigns in the world. The contacts you make and the friendships you build are unimaginable in two and a half days. There&rsquo;s really nothing else quite like PRovoke Global Summit.&rdquo;</p>

                    <h2>WARC</h2>
<p class="first">We&rsquo;re excited to welcome WARC, the World Advertising Research Centre, as an Official SABRE Showcase Partner to increase exposure to your work.</p>
<p> Marketers at over 1,000 agencies and brands worldwide use WARC to quickly find insights, best practices, and case examples to shape and validate their thinking.</p>

							if (ev.keyCode == 13) {
								var but = input.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode.getElementsByTagName("button")[0];
								if (but) {
									if (but.click) {
										but.click();
									}
									else if (but.onclick) {
										but.focus();
										var click = but.onclick;
										but.onclick = null;
										if (click) click.call(but);
									}
								}
								return false;
							}
							else return true;
						}
